verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform, so a managed global AI inference API is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only general app hosting: CPU/RAM scaling, replicas, and running apps closer to users. There is no documented serverless model-inference call, no managed GPU offering, and no capacity-free inference capability. Regional app deployment and AI-agent tooling are adjacent features, not inference-as-a-service.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning
